sentences.text: 2. Heard the learned Counsel for the Petitioner and the learned Assistant Public Prosecutor.
Perused the record.
3. As seen from the record, a learned Single Judge of this Court, vide order dated 29.05.2025 in Crl.P.No.5665 of 2025, granted pre-arrest bail to Accused No.1.
Another learned Single Judge of this Court, vide order dated 30.06.2025 in Crl.P.No.5981 of 2025, granted similar relief to Accused No.8.
Similarly, a learned Single Judge of this Court, in Crl.P.No.6187 of 2025, vide order dated 30.06.2025, granted pre-arrest bail to Accused No.4.
The allegations against the petitioner/Accused No. 10 also stand on the same footing as those against the other accused.

4. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the gravity and nature of the allegations levelled against the petitioner/Accuse d No. 10, this Dr. YLR.J Crl..PNo.13256of2025 ' Dated 29.12.2025 Court is inclined to grant pre-arrest bail to the petitioner/Acc used No. 10, with some stringent conditions.

5. In the result, the Criminal Petition is allowed with the following conditions:
i.

In the event of his arrest, the petitioner/Accused No. 10 shall be enlarged on bail subject to his executing a bond for a sum of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand only) with two sureties for the like sum each to the satisfaction of the arresting police officials.
ii. The petitioner/Accused No. 10 shall appear before the Station House Officer concerned once in a week i.e., on every Saturday between 10.00 a.m. and 5.00 p.m., till filing of the charge sheet.
iii. The petitioner/Accused No. 10 shall cooperate with the Investigation Officer and shall make himself available for investigation as and when required.

iv. The petitioner/Accused No. 10 shall not cause any threat, inducement or promise to the Nagireddy Mohan Kumar vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 29 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/7533822/
2 prosecution witnesses.
